lead: Renders the Markdown of AI replies. The parser is our own, with no dependencies: headings, paragraphs, fenced code (with Code Block), quotes, lists and task lists, tables, rules, and inline code / bold / italic / strikethrough / links / images. It caches by block, which suits streaming output; HTML is not recognized, and links and images only accept safe addresses.

usage.title: Usage
usage.sample:
# Heading 1
## Heading 2

A paragraph with **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `inline code` and a [link](https://base-ui.com).
Bare links work too, no brackets needed: https://example.com

> A quote with **emphasis**.

```ts
const answer: number = 42; // the answer
```

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: The text keeps being appended: unchanged blocks are not redrawn, and an unclosed bold / code fence is shown as raw text until it closes, so it doesn't swallow what follows.
streaming.sample:
## Streaming demo

The answer is rendered **block by block**. Blocks that did not change are not re-rendered,
and an unfinished construct such as **bold or a code fence stays plain text until it closes.

```js
function hello() {
  console.log("streaming…");
}
```

- first point
- second point

Done.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: With `citations`, `[1]`, `[2]` in the text become citation badges: clicking opens the source, and a source with a `description` shows a preview card on hover.
citations.sample: Base UI ships unstyled components[1] and a skin layer adds the look[2]. An unknown marker like [9] stays plain text.

math.title: Math
math.description: Pass a render function to `math` (KaTeX here, loaded on demand). Math is not built into the library, and dollar signs in prices are not mistaken for formulas.
math.sample:
The energy is $E = mc^2$, and Euler's identity is \(e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0\).

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$

Prices are not math: it costs $5 today and $10 tomorrow.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: HTML is plain text; links and images only accept http(s) / mailto / tel and relative addresses, anything like `javascript:` keeps just its text.
safety.sample:
[javascript link](javascript:alert(1)) stays plain text,
<script>alert(1)</script> is shown as text, not run,
and ![bad image](javascript:alert(1)) is not rendered.
[Safe link](https://example.com) works.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: Root element. Headings / paragraphs / lists / quotes / rules / tables inside it are styled with tag selectors
styling.math: Container of a formula (its content comes from the `math` function); `data-display`: inline / block, block formulas are centered and scroll horizontally when too wide
styling.task: The read-only box before a task item (`role=checkbox`); `data-checked`; its `li` has `data-task`
styling.caret: The cursor after the last text while streaming (`aria-hidden`); the root has `data-streaming`
styling.tableWrap: The table's scroll area (`role=region`, focusable); `th` / `td` have `data-align`
